trait.name: Abyssal Resistance
trait.description: You have 50 percent resistance to poison damage.

trait.name: Poison Spray
trait.description: At character level 1, know Poison Spray and cast it at will.

trait.name: Ray Of Sickness
trait.description: At character level 3, always have Ray Of Sickness available. Cast it once without using a spell slot per Long Rest, and also with appropriate spell slots.

trait.name: Hold Person
trait.description: At character level 5, always have Hold Person available. Cast it once without using a spell slot per Long Rest, and also with appropriate spell slots.
